real_task: Publish this session through immutable GitHub connector objects while preserving the locally tested tree.
observed_problem: Session 026 transferred one large file through a capped output, created a wrong blob and then a wrong remote tree before the final tree comparison caught the mismatch.
baseline: Expected blob IDs were reconstructed ad hoc after remote writes; 1 of 9 blobs and 1 remote tree were wrong before detection.
hypothesis: A compact local manifest of base/target trees and per-path Git object IDs lets an agent compare every connector blob before creating a remote tree, localizing truncation earlier.
quality_control: The manifest must match native Git IDs for modified, added and deleted files, preserve unusual path characters, reject invalid/non-ancestor revisions, remain read-only and pass the full suite. Final publication must still compare the remote tree with the tested local tree.
overhead: Count implementation, tests, documentation, manifest generation, connector calls, reporting and checkpoint maintenance. Do not infer token or time savings.
stop_condition: Implement one dependency-free JSON CLI and use it once on this real publication. Do not automate credentials, ref movement or network writes; a no-mismatch run remains insufficient for a positive utility claim.

result.implementation: publish-manifest emits a compact read-only JSON receipt for resolved commits/trees and changed target objects; connector writes and ref movement remain outside the command.
result.correctness: Six targeted tests cover add/change/delete, a path containing whitespace and newline, read-only status preservation, invalid/non-ancestor revisions, nested root and compact CLI JSON.
result.reason: Correctness is established, but this build has not yet faced a naturally truncated connector transfer. A clean publication cannot show that earlier mismatch localization improves real recovery.
result.next_test: On the next natural connector blob mismatch, compare whether per-blob OID checking prevents an incorrect remote tree before creation; otherwise keep the command frozen.
